comment:overrides: react-router and zustand hoist to the root, where their react>=18 peer was satisfied by a second copy of React 18 while the app ran on React 19 in frontend/node_modules. Two copies means two dispatchers, and the app died on first render with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading useRef)'. Pin every resolution to one version.
comment:engines: Floor is set by Vite 7. Do not raise it to react-router 8's >=22.22.0 — hosts commonly ship 22.18.x, which that version refuses.
